descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S09 Rolled Consult (Hospital), rolled New Admission and rolled Consult (Nursing Home) read Follow-up and the pre-selection follows; a rolled patient set again by hand holds

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 New Admission and Consult both roll to Follow-up on the next calendar day without the physician touching them; a status set today stays today (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 4)
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • T2 Discharge templates (Discharge summary; SNF discharge once it exists) are never pre-selected by the badge in either context; they are only chosen by hand (UAT TC-06 step 6) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92599 AC 6)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital patient seeded Consult set yesterday; Nursing Home resident seeded New Admission set yesterday; a second resident seeded Consult set yesterday

When Open each list and chart without touching anything; then set the Hospital patient to New Admission by hand, reload, and let the runner call rounding:applyLifecycle with today

Then All three read Follow-up on the list and in the chart; SOAP progress / SNF follow-up pre-selected; never Consult note, SNF admission or a discharge template; the Hospital patient set again to New Admission stays New Admission with encTypeDay = today after the reload and after the lifecycle run

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 'New Admission and Consult both roll to Follow-up on the next calendar day' + 'the badge can be changed by hand at any time' + 'the badge only pre-selects'. oracle.mjs on list text and [selected] options. Positive control before the agent starts: the runner reads rounding:list / snf:list and requires encType 'consult' / 'new' / 'consult' with encTypeDay < today on th …

Where it ran: dev unit U58; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
